name: guygrigsby-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Guy Grigsby

plugins.name: agent-ready
plugins.description: Keep a repo optimized for coding agents. Audits seven agent-ergonomics dimensions, auto-fixes the safe class, and enforces line budget + context drift via hooks.

plugins.name: db-schemas
plugins.description: Integrity-first SQL DDL. Fires whenever DDL is written or reviewed: the database generates ids and timestamps, every reference is an FK with explicit ON DELETE, a fact that happens later is its own table instead of a nullable status column, closed vocabularies are seeded enum tables, real types for time and money, NOT NULL by default with every surviving NULL explained, 5NF with recorded exceptions, every index naming the query it serves.

plugins.name: ddd
plugins.description: Domain-driven design and contract completeness for every design session. Subdomain distillation, model-sized bounded contexts, entity/VO/enum-classified objects each documented in one self-contained section with every field, behavior, relationship cardinality and state, optionality justified rather than assumed, later facts as their own tables instead of nullable columns, constructor-enforced invariants, aggregate discipline with domain events, anti-corruption layers, then API, domain event and DDL contracts each defined to 100% and cross-checked, captured as a context map, a domain model and an ADR before code. Integrity-first DDL writing rules live in the companion db-schemas plugin.

plugins.name: drift-guards
plugins.description: Every fact that lives in more than one place gets a test comparing the copies, code side as the source of truth. Guard shapes for doc tables, config keys, version strings, generated artifacts, examples, paths, and schemas, wired into the project's default test gate.

plugins.name: gyr-fleet
plugins.description: Register each Claude Code session in the gyr fleet: heartbeat on session start and every prompt, mark done on session end. Best-effort via the local gyr CLI; never blocks a session.

plugins.name: my-voice
plugins.description: Build a personal writing-voice corpus from email, blog, and GitHub PR/review history; distill it into a style guide; draft new text in your own voice.

plugins.name: sno
plugins.description: Straightforward spec-driven development. Learn, plan, build, check, ship.

plugins.name: wu
plugins.description: Zero-slop development with persona-driven analysis and cloud-first agent dispatch.

plugins.name: your-voice
plugins.description: The mirror of my-voice: talk to the user the way they need. Interaction modes inferred silently from communication style, layered on a sacred baseline disposition, injected always-on via a SessionStart hook.
